name: Thunderhorn Cleansing

narrative.details:
The totem is ready, adventurer.  And again, it is your task to perform the ritual of cleansing.

Go to the Thunderhorn Water Well, north of the village, and use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem in your ritual.  After you do this, return to me.

May the spirits guide you.
narrative.objectives: Use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem at the Thunderhorn Water Well, then return to Mull.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ancestors of the Thunderhorn clan spoke to me in a dream, praising you for your actions near their well.

For their gratitude, they wish to give you this...
narrative.requestItemsText: The Thunderhorn Water Well is still tainted, adventurer.  Please, you must perform the ritual!
